note: Source inventory. See DATA_SOURCES.md for the human-readable table. 'level' follows the source hierarchy in ARCHITECTURE.md (1 = official/regulatory … 6 = general websites).

sources.name: CDS curated clinical layer
sources.description: Hand-authored lexicon (symptom synonyms incl. romanised Hindi), red-flag rule encodings, application safety rules and terminology bridges written for this project, each citing its upstream authority.
sources.recommendedUse: Seed rules; every fact is marked curated-pending-verification until clinical-governance sign-off.
sources.provenance: Authored during this build from the cited primary sources.
sources.notes: Not an authority in itself. Requires review by a clinical safety officer before clinical use.

sources.name: ICMR Treatment Guidelines for Antimicrobial Use in Common Syndromes
sources.description: ICMR national guidance on antimicrobial use in common infectious syndromes (2nd edition 2019; revised edition Nov 2022 found).
sources.recommendedUse: Cite by link for antimicrobial stewardship statements; paraphrase only.
sources.notes: Content not copied. The URTI 'no antibiotics' rule cites this guideline by link and paraphrase.

sources.name: MoHFW / Clinical Establishments Standard Treatment Guidelines
sources.description: Standard treatment guidelines across specialties (cardiology, critical care, obstetrics, paediatrics, dengue, snakebite, rabies, malaria, etc.).
sources.dataLicense: Government of India publication (reuse terms not stated)
sources.recommendedUse: Primary India-first guideline reference; link and paraphrase.
sources.notes: PDF guidelines not bundled because reuse terms are not explicit. Future importer should record guideline title/version/date as metadata only.

sources.name: National List of Essential Medicines (India) 2022
sources.description: NLEM 2022: 384 medicines in 27 therapeutic categories (latest version found).
sources.recommendedUse: Flag whether a candidate is on NLEM (future importer).
sources.notes: NLEM membership not yet imported; importer stub planned. No NLEM status is displayed to avoid unverified claims.

sources.name: Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO)
sources.description: Indian drug regulator: approvals, banned FDC lists, safety alerts.
sources.recommendedUse: Reference for Indian approval status and banned fixed-dose combinations.
sources.notes: Not imported.

sources.name: Pharmacovigilance Programme of India (PvPI)
sources.description: National ADR reporting programme run by the Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission.
sources.recommendedUse: Link from adverse-effect sections for ADR reporting.
sources.notes: No bulk data API found.

sources.name: RxNorm (NLM)
sources.description: Normalized names and identifiers (RXCUI) for clinical drugs; ingredient, strength, dose form, brand relationships.
sources.dataLicense: Full release requires UMLS licence; Current Prescribable Content and RxNav APIs available without licence
importedFields: rxcui (curated, to be verified by importer)
sources.recommendedUse: Canonical ingredient identifiers. RXCUIs in the seed set are curated and must be verified with `npm run import:rxnav`.
sources.provenance: NLM. RxClass content includes SNOMED CT (affiliate licence).
sources.notes: RxNav API is not reachable from the build sandbox; verification pending.
sources.attributionText: This product uses publicly available data from the U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM), National Institutes of Health, Department of Health and Human Services; NLM is not responsible for the product and does not endorse or recommend this or any other product.

sources.name: DailyMed (NLM) — Structured Product Labeling
sources.description: FDA-submitted product labels: indications, contraindications, warnings, boxed warnings, interactions, adverse reactions.
sources.recommendedUse: Label source for contraindications/warnings; link each drug to DailyMed search.
sources.notes: Seed facts paraphrased from labels; openFDA label importer verifies sections when network is available.

sources.name: openFDA drug APIs
sources.description: Drug label, adverse event (FAERS), NDC, recall, Drugs@FDA, shortages endpoints.
sources.dataLicense: Public domain (CC0) with openFDA terms; not for clinical decision-making without validation
sources.notes: FAERS reports are not causal evidence. api.fda.gov is not reachable from the build sandbox.

sources.name: DrugCentral
sources.description: Drug indications, contraindications, targets, pharmacologic actions, identifiers.
sources.recommendedUse: Enrichment of indications/targets via user-run import (share-alike obligations apply to derived data).
sources.notes: Not bundled to keep the core dataset free of share-alike obligations; adapter documented.
